map.电池匹配寿命计算 使用指南: Battery Matching Life Calculation User Guide
map.输入设备功率、电池容量与电压，计算电池续航工作时间与理论可用电量，用于设备供电方: Enter device power, battery capacity and voltage to compute battery runtime and theoretical usable energy, for device power supply planning and battery selection.
map.输入设备功率、电池容量与电压，计算电池续航时间与理论可用电量: Enter device power, battery capacity and voltage to compute battery runtime and theoretical usable energy
map.由容量、电压、效率、放电深度估算续航时间。: Estimate runtime from capacity, voltage, efficiency and depth of discharge.
map.对比不同电池方案可用电量。: Compare usable capacity across battery options.
map.选型避免中途断电。: Select for size to avoid mid-run power loss.
map.：电池 5000mAh、3.7V、效率 85%、DoD 80%、负载 10W：理: : battery 5000 mAh, 3.7 V, efficiency 85%, DoD 80%, load 10 W: theoretical energy = 5 × 3.7 = 18.5 Wh, usable = 18.5 × 0.85 × 0.8 = 12.58 Wh, runtime T = 12.58 ÷ 10 ≈ 1.26 h (about 1 hour 16 minutes).
map.：若 DoD 提到 100%：可用 = 18.5×0.85 = 15.7Wh，续: : if DoD goes to 100%: usable = 18.5 × 0.85 = 15.7 Wh, runtime ≈ 1.57 h; but deep discharge harms battery life, so it is usually held at 80%.
map.放电深度，可用电量占比；DoD 80% 表示只用 80% 容量，保留余量延长循环: Depth of discharge, the share of capacity used; DoD 80% means only 80% of capacity is used, keeping a margin that extends cycle life, and traction batteries are often limited to 80-90%.
map.容量 Ah 和 Wh 什么关系？: How are capacity Ah and Wh related?
map.Wh = Ah×V，是能量而非电荷；同 Ah 下电压高则能量大、续航长，选型看: Wh = Ah × V is energy, not charge; at the same Ah a higher voltage means more energy and longer runtime, so Wh is the better figure for selection.
